newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India shares up as Bombay nears 4,000.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India shares up as Bombay nears 4,000.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts rose smartly Thursday as the Bombay blue-chip index closed in on the 4,000-point barrier.
Bombay's benchmark index closed up 55 points, or nearly 1.5 percent, at 3,982.95.
Traders said there was two-way trading Thursday, but sentiment was helped by the continued rally in Reliance, which rose $1.36 to $22.00/$23.00 on continued bonus-share speculation.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 2.39 points up at 86.64, with the premium over the local market at 27.69 percent from 25.80 percent.
Telco gained 97 cents to $13.60/$14.35 and Indian Hotels rose 25 cents to $24.00/$25.00.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index closed up 1.81 points, or 2.44 percent, to 75.80 points, a premium of 44.60 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index rose 2.68 points, or 2.25 percent, to 121.98, representing a discount to the local market of 2.59 percent.
